failure_modes: Unvalidated time-conditioned contrast (C008-C011) could reverse sign within the window and displace surrounding coordinates without endpoint affinity benefit.
Dose-only edits (C001/C003) alter the robust kernel without evidence of endpoint advantage; C002 and C006 duplicate incumbent values.
Static attention/teacher-count edits (C004/C005/C007) are not supported by temporal evidence and risk unnecessary displacement of neighboring observed nodes.
No decoded terminal affinity labels are available, so any claimed affinity gain from these edits would be unverifiable in this turn.
result.rationale: D1.2: The incumbent is a stationary coordinate target (reward_view endpoint_pointcloud, teacher_score_beta 0, time_ramp_power 0.0, window [0.0,0.5]) with no temporal teacher term. The permitted time-conditioned alternatives are the registered temporal_region (C008) and temporal_teacher (C009-C011) recipes, which change regional attention or blend a validated observed-node contrast teacher; they do not change teacher coordinates into velocity targets, and the endpoint VJP remains the only coordinate gradient. Analyst's temporal evidence (continuous:0-5) shows non-monotone observed-node contrast with four to ten sign changes and large opposing first/last rate z-values, but polynomial_accepted false, extrapolation_allowed false and relative node RMSE ~0.29-0.78, so no validated time-conditioned contrast is established and H001's falsifier (no registered recipe can express the contrast, or the fit fails to reproduce the sign changes) is not cleared. D4.1: Against the incumbent, the offered edits are pointcloud_delta_A (C001-C003), region_index (C004), teacher_neighbors (C005-C007) and the temporal recipes (C008-C011). The incumbent already uses pointcloud_delta_A 1.0 and teacher_neighbors 4, so C002 and C006 are no-ops; C001/C003 change only the robust-kernel dose, C004/C005/C007 change static attention or teacher count without temporal evidence, and C008-C011 require the unvalidated temporal contrast. No offered choice has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first objective, so retaining the incumbent is the evidence-supported decision. D4.2: The predicted failure of an unsupported temporal or attention edit is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates: the regional recipe uses a detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention with positive surrounding weight, so a mis-signed or mis-timed contrast would pull neighboring observed nodes away from their native positions while the endpoint pointcloud reward still scores only the detached-Hungarian endpoint distance; because recorded affinities are removed and no decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied, such displacement could not be shown to improve final predicted affinity. This prediction keeps the design at the incumbent rather than accepting a coordinate-graph or attention change on descriptive diagnostics alone.
